title: SEC-3: full credential scrub on Discord and diff-review output
head: 567e5fe159a61c7d2a807ef9ba27e86775f9d391
brief: redact.scrub_text is the one scrub for model-written text bound for a surface. Older outbound surfaces still call secrets.scrub alone, which knows only Jarvis-owned credential values. This PR routes the Discord chat mirror, task reporter, diff-review output and chat-git results through scrub_text, which also redacts provider key shapes and bearer/JWT shapes. Text that cannot be scrubbed is replaced with a withheld marker; diff review withholds instead of raising. The Discord approval DM is deliberately left alone (cards redact via redact_command; a value that runs is never hidden). Acceptance tests were committed first and fail on main.
focus: correctness, including under concurrency and across the ordering of events
handling of untrusted input, and safety-boundary changes
test coverage of the new behaviour: would the tests fail without the change?
claims in the description against the evidence in the diff and tests

ground_truth.mechanism: diff_review._clean scrubs first and strips invisible characters after, so a key split by a zero-width or bidi character (ghp_AB\u200bCD...) slips past scrub_text and is then joined back together
ground_truth.evidence: swap the two calls; fixed by #248 with a test using U+200B, U+2060, U+202E, U+FEFF
ground_truth.source: lead review of #245 (transcript record); fixed in #248
